card.name: Inside all-caps boxed warning text
card.fires_on: Word endings and small linking words inside ALL-CAPS warning text, such as the ED in BOXED or FOLLOWED and AND, OR, FOR, IN in capitalized warning headings.

modes.label: Ending of capitalized word
modes.description: The closing piece of a long all-caps word such as BOXED, FOLLOWED, SEEN or CARDIOVASCULAR.
modes.example: SEE FULL PRESCRIBING INFORMATION FOR COMPLETE BOX<<ED>> WARNING.

modes.label: Linking word in caps heading
modes.description: A small word like AND, OR, FOR or IN joining terms in an all-caps warning title.
modes.example: RISKS FROM CONCOMITANT USE WITH BENZODIAZEPINES<< OR>> OTHER CNS DEPRESSANTS

card.writes: It seems to hold back tokens starting with a capital W, and to favor a few unrelated W-words.
card.plain: It lights up on the later parts of words and joining words in shouted, all-capital warning headings.
